evidence_scope: summary-level mocker throughput characterization, not a promotion-grade request-ID, tail-SLO, or GPU audit
instrument_activation: Every Job Pod executed a pre-profile assertion that MemoryMapDatasetClient.get_conversation.__module__ is sitecustomize; all Jobs completed, and their captured Pod specs contain the digest-named ConfigMap mount and PYTHONPATH.
integrity_checks: Frozen plan SHA256 and trace SHA256 checked before each run.
Exact Nix bundle, 1/8/8/32 serving replica topology, and 20+20 gateway threads checked before each run.
AIPerf version, fixed-schedule phase, zero exported error counts, and no cancelled clients checked from every raw summary.
All client Pod logs prove mmap-cache HIT and tokenizer/composer skip.
limitations: AIPerf summary export has no request-level JSONL, so request-ID completeness and tail-metric recomputation are not independently auditable.
Other-namespace client-node occupancy was observed after the runs but not sampled during them.
vCluster Metrics API was unavailable; one Envoy cgroup CPU sample was collected during the 24-client measured phase, but no synchronized per-stage/client profile exists.
No user SLO was specified, and the worker is synthetic rather than a production GPU worker.
decision: Three zero-error summary-level points establish that the two-node load-generation-plus-serving setup plateaus near 8250 RPS at 18-24 clients. They do not establish the single-gateway hard ceiling. Control client placement and measure stage/client CPU before attributing the plateau.
